description:
Shortlist providers for a job and place. Ranked: lists the region > lists the country > lists part of the country > headquartered there (HQ is not a service area) > works worldwide. Each result has coverage + coverage_reason, engagement models, published pricing with USD conversion, min_published_price_usd and public contact routes. Coverage is country-level unless the provider published regions. Filters combine (AND).
Example: {"use_case":"drone-light-show","country":"AE"}; {"use_case":"commercial-floor-scrubbing","country":"CA","region":"ON","engagement_model":"raas"}.

country.description: Buyer country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 ("AE") or English name ("United Arab Emirates").

has_contact.description: Only providers with a public email, phone or quote form

hq_country.description: Only providers headquartered in this country

include_global.description: Include providers that only say "worldwide" when a country is given

max_price_usd.description: Only providers whose lowest published price (converted to USD) is at or below this. Excludes providers without published prices.

near.description: "me" = the country Cloudflare sees for this request (never stored), or a country name/code. Coordinates are not supported.

region.description: Sub-country region code or name, e.g. "US-CA", "ON", "Mendoza"

robot_type.description: Substring match on robot types, e.g. "drone", "AMR", "humanoid"

name: find_providers

coverage.description: How this provider relates to the requested place (serves region / country / part / HQ only / worldwide)

as_of.description: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD the source states

source_url.description: Public page that states this price

usd.description: Labelled currency conversion at a dated FX rate (never a quote)

title: Find providers
